title: System roles have no Delete option anywhere
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the Roles & Permissions list.
custom_steps:
1. For each of the 11 system roles, look at the Actions column.
  2. For the editable system roles that have a three-dot menu (for example Service Manager, Foreman), open the menu.
  3. Look at the menu options.
custom_expected:
Administrator, Office User and Time Clock User show only the eye icon (no three-dot menu).

The other editable system roles show a pencil, an eye and a three-dot menu.

None of the three-dot menus has a Delete option.
evidence: UI: editable system role 3-dot shows only View Permissions (no Delete); non-editable system roles have no 3-dot at all. No Delete anywhere for system roles.
